About.subtitle: About Me
About.title: Product-minded Full Stack Developer
About.p1: I'm <1>Kayo Weiber</1>, {{age}} years old, and I study Information Systems at UEMG. I build digital solutions that connect interface, business logic, and data to solve real problems.
About.p2: My foundation spans technical support, computer maintenance, and software development. That combination helps me understand the whole system, from user experience to API integrations, databases, and automations.
About.p3: I currently work as a <1>Development Assistant II</1> at <0>Cervejaria Cidade Imperial</0>, focused on <2>web applications, integrations, and process improvement</2>, while continuously evolving to deliver clearer, reliable, and scalable software.

coursesPage.title: Courses and Certifications
coursesPage.metaDescription: Kayo Weiber's courses, certifications, and study tracks in full-stack development, cloud, data, and programming fundamentals.

list.title: AWS Academy Graduate – Cloud Architecting – Training Badge
list.description: I completed the AWS Academy Graduate – Cloud Architecting – Training Badge course, offered by Amazon Web Services (AWS). This training strengthened my knowledge of cloud computing, solution architecture, and IT infrastructure, broadening my understanding of best practices for using AWS services.

list.title: Software Architecture & Modern Systems Design
list.description: I learned to design scalable and resilient software architectures, using modern patterns and best practices to ensure the efficiency and maintainability of developed systems.

list.title: Azure DevOps - Board, Repos, Pipeline, Test Plans, and Artifacts
list.description: Overview of Azure DevOps with a practical focus on Azure Pipelines (CI/CD), configuring builds and releases via both Classic Editor and YAML.

list.title: AWS Academy Graduate - Cloud Foundations
list.description: I completed the AWS Academy Cloud Foundations course, gaining essential knowledge of AWS services and solutions, including cloud computing, storage, databases, networking, and security.

list.title: Spring Boot 2025: REST APIs from Zero to AWS & GCP with Java and Docker
list.description: I learned to build REST APIs with Spring Boot, using Java and Docker, and deploy them to AWS and GCP, exploring Swagger, Kubernetes, K8s RESTful APIs, JWT, JUnit 5, Mockito, and React JS.

list.title: Introduction to Software Testing
list.description: I acquired knowledge about the fundamentals and importance of software testing to ensure quality, learning about different types of tests, such as unit and integration, and their role in the development cycle.

list.title: SOLID and Clean Code in Java: Writing High-Quality Code
list.description: I applied the five SOLID principles and Clean Code concepts in the context of the Java language to build robust, flexible, and easily maintainable software, following the best practices of object-oriented programming.

list.title: Introduction to Clean Code
list.description: I learned the essential principles for writing readable and easily maintainable code, focusing on techniques such as using meaningful names, creating functions with a single responsibility, and consistent code formatting.

list.title: JavaScript and TypeScript: From Beginner to Advanced (JS/TS)
list.description: I learned JavaScript and TypeScript, from the fundamentals to advanced concepts for front-end and back-end development, covering technologies such as Node, Express, NoSQL, React, Hooks, Redux, and Design Patterns.

list.title: MySQL
list.description: I learned to work with the MySQL relational database management system, focusing on data modeling and executing SQL queries to create, manipulate, and query information in a structured way.

list.title: AI Journey: Prompt Engineering
list.description: I trained in prompt engineering to interact effectively with Artificial Intelligence models, learning to structure clear and contextual instructions to generate accurate and optimized results.

list.title: Git and GitHub
list.description: I studied the Git version control system to manage project history and the use of GitHub to host remote repositories, collaborate in teams, and manage branches efficiently.

list.title: Introduction to Data Analysis - Microsoft Power BI
list.description: I developed skills to transform raw data into insights with Microsoft Power BI, learning to import, process data, and create interactive reports and dashboards for information visualization and analysis.

list.title: JavaScript
list.description: I deepened my knowledge in JavaScript, covering from basic syntax and DOM manipulation to fundamental concepts for creating interactivity on web pages, such as events, functions, and data structures.

list.title: Hardware
list.description: I studied the fundamental components that make up a computer, such as the processor, RAM, and motherboard. I learned about their functions, interconnections, and the basic principles of equipment assembly and maintenance.
